purpose: Bind the existing V2 final_negative_history_hash to an independently auditable append-only host-custody chain instead of accepting an arbitrary syntactically valid digest.

append_link.ordered_by: result archive record order at host observation time
append_link.custody: The host appends a link when the corresponding staged record is admitted. Candidate processes do not select, rewrite, delete, reorder, or truncate prior links.

finalization.document_hash: SHA256 of the canonical chain document excluding document_hash
required_checks: host-selected expected chain document hash matches the loaded document
run_manifest_hash matches the exact run manifest
link count equals result archive record count
each link binds the record at the same archive position
every previous_chain_hash equals the preceding verified tip
archive.final_negative_history_hash equals the verified final chain tip

failure_policy: Any missing, reordered, truncated, substituted, forked, stale-root, or hash-mismatched chain is CANNOT_CHECK and blocks finalized V2 evidence admission.
authority_boundary: A valid chain proves content/ordering integrity only. It cannot establish scientific correctness, causal attribution, beneficial transfer, or promotion authority.
